purpose: Phase-6D tumour-response FORMULATION profiles. Surface-charged tripterine-loaded NLCs (cationic / anionic / neutral), free tripterine, and a vehicle control are kept as SEPARATE profiles - never merged into one universal NLC. The Chen 2012 in vivo antimelanoma pharmacodynamic evidence supports the treatment DIRECTION and the cationic > (anionic / neutral) RANKING (and NLC over tripterine alone) qualitatively; exact effect differences / percentages / tumour-volume gaps are NOT_REPORTED. Effect classes are ordinal, evidence- or prediction-labelled.

cationic_nlc.label: Cationic tripterine-loaded NLC
cationic_nlc.uncertainty: Direction + strongest-formulation ranking are experimentally supported (Chen 2012); exact effect magnitude / % tumour-growth inhibition NOT_REPORTED.

anionic_nlc.label: Anionic tripterine-loaded NLC
anionic_nlc.uncertainty: Lower relative antimelanoma direction than cationic (Chen 2012); exact magnitude NOT_REPORTED; anionic-vs-neutral ordering not over-claimed.

neutral_nlc.label: Neutral tripterine-loaded NLC
neutral_nlc.uncertainty: Lower relative antimelanoma direction than cationic (Chen 2012); exact magnitude NOT_REPORTED; anionic-vs-neutral ordering not over-claimed.

free_tripterine.label: Free tripterine (celastrol)
free_tripterine.uncertainty: NLC formulations improved performance over tripterine alone where reported (Chen 2012); exact gap NOT_REPORTED.

vehicle_control.label: Vehicle / untreated control
vehicle_control.uncertainty: Untreated / vehicle reference trajectory (schematic baseline growth); exact control curve NOT_REPORTED.

ranking_policy.supported_ranking: cationic_nlc > anionic_nlc and cationic_nlc > neutral_nlc; NLC formulations > free_tripterine; vehicle_control has no treatment effect.
ranking_policy.not_over_claimed: The anionic-vs-neutral ordering and any exact effect differences are NOT asserted.
ranking_policy.cell_model_scope: This ranking is B16BL6-specific (Chen 2012); it is not transferred to B16 / B16-F10 without an explicit context-transfer label.
